# MinePeak — PEAK bridge

This directory contains MinePeak's PEAK BepInEx component, adapted from
[PeakCraft](https://github.com/aeironnsarmiento/PeakCraft) and
[SkyCraft](https://github.com/chasmlol/SkyCraft).

Use the current [MinePeak README](../../../README.md) for architecture, installation,
build instructions, controls and limitations, and [PLAY.md](../../../PLAY.md) for
playing on the configured computer. The [verification record](../../../docs/VERIFICATION.md)
distinguishes completed checks from remaining live tests.

The PEAK plugin's display name and package name are **MinePeak**. The inherited
`PeakCraft` namespace, `aeironnarmiento.PeakCraft.dll` assembly/plugin GUID and
`aeironnarmiento.PeakCraft.cfg` config filename are retained for compatibility.
The Minecraft component likewise retains its `skycraft` mod ID and `SkyCraft`
save directory. These identifiers are not the current project's name.

Upstream MIT licences and third-party notices remain in the parent directory.
See [UPSTREAM.md](../../../UPSTREAM.md) for credits and the pinned source revision.
